landing.hero.description: Master sign language with interactive lessons powered by AI. Practice in real-time, get instant feedback, and track your progress all from your browser.
landing.features.subtitle: The most interactive way to learn sign language
landing.feature.realtime.title: Real-Time Recognition
landing.feature.realtime.body: Use your camera to practice signs and get instant feedback on your hand positions and movements.
landing.feature.adaptive.title: Adaptive Learning
landing.feature.adaptive.body: Personalized lessons that adapt to your pace and focus on areas where you need more practice.
landing.feature.gamified.title: Gamified Progress
landing.feature.gamified.body: Earn badges, level up, and compete with friends as you master each sign and lesson.
landing.feature.conversation.title: Conversation Practice
landing.feature.conversation.body: Practice real conversations with interactive scenarios that simulate everyday situations.
landing.feature.track.title: Track Your Journey
landing.feature.track.body: Visualize your progress with detailed stats and insights into your learning patterns.
landing.feature.multiple.title: Multiple Sign Languages
landing.feature.multiple.body: Learn ASL, BSL, and other sign languages with region-specific lessons and vocabulary.
landing.how.subtitle: Get started in three simple steps
landing.how.step1.title: Choose Your Path
landing.how.step1.body: Select your sign language and skill level. Start with basics or jump to advanced lessons.
landing.how.step2.title: Practice with AI
landing.how.step2.body: Follow along with video demonstrations, then use your camera to practice. Our AI gives you real-time feedback.
landing.how.step3.title: Master and Progress
landing.how.step3.body: Complete quizzes, unlock new levels, and watch yourself become fluent in sign language.
landing.faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about SignLingo
landing.faq.a1: Yes. The core learning curriculum is completely free and accessible to everyone. For users who want an ad-free experience and access to advanced features, we offer a premium subscription.
landing.faq.q2: How does the AI feedback system work?
landing.faq.a2: Our AI uses your device camera to analyze your signing in real time and compares your hand movements to the target sign so you can improve with immediate feedback.
landing.faq.q3: Do I need any prior experience to start learning?
landing.faq.a3: Not at all. SignLingo is designed for learners of all levels and starts with the basics before progressing to more advanced signs.
landing.faq.q4: How is SignLingo different from watching video tutorials?
landing.faq.a4: Unlike passive video tutorials, SignLingo gives you active practice with camera-based feedback so you can actually improve your signing technique.
landing.cta.title: Ready to Start Your Journey?
landing.cta.body: Join thousands of learners mastering sign language through interactive practice.
landing.footer: Making sign language accessible to everyone.
